facts.text: I want to build a showcase/community website for software engineering college students to showcase their work and connect with each other via the website.
The target audience is software engineering college students in one major.
There are currently 4 generations of the student community.
Some of the first generation have graduated.
I want ideas for questions for user research.
I have ideas that the website could reference awwwards.com.
I want problem and solution statements that could fit in sticky notes.
